title: Gates that review as well as block
message: Nothing AI-made reaches an audience until its checks pass — claims are sourced, images are looked at, and no number is ever invented
audience: Teams that need to trust AI-generated content

scenes.headline: Gates that review, as well as *block.*
scenes.narration: Nothing AI-made reaches an audience until its required checks pass. That is a rule, not a setting. Here is what the gates actually check.

scenes.headline: Seven checks before anything goes *live.*
scenes.narration: Every article carries a checklist. Metadata, slug and focus keyword. Alt text on every image. No unsourced claims. Every citation verified. A branded social preview image. Under full autonomy the app does that review work itself, and only holds what it genuinely cannot fix.

callouts.text: It only holds what it genuinely cannot fix.

scenes.headline: Sourced, not *asserted.*
scenes.narration: Claims are sourced, not asserted. The writer marks factual claims. Live web search looks for a real source, and an independent judge has to agree that the source actually supports the sentence. Topical overlap is not support. A claim with no support waits for you, with two buttons: verify with a link, or drop it.

callouts.label: Step 2
callouts.title: Live web search finds a source; an independent judge must agree

scenes.headline: Every AI image is *looked at.*
scenes.narration: Every AI image is looked at. A vision model inspects each render for cut-off text, wrong brand names and glitches. After two failed renders it stops spending and asks a person. Approve it, or pick or upload another.

callouts.label: The brake
callouts.title: failed renders, then it asks a person

scenes.headline: Asked once. Banked *forever.*
scenes.narration: When an article needs knowledge only you have, the question is asked once, in your Inbox. Your answer is woven into the article and banked to the expert profile, so it is never asked again. Every clearing act moves the article at once.

callouts.label: Asked
callouts.title: then banked to the expert profile

callouts.text: Every clearing act moves the article at once.

scenes.headline: A dash means *not measured.*
scenes.narration: And the same honesty runs through the numbers. A dash means not measured, never zero. Outlier ratios, best time to post, search and engagement figures are measured or absent. This app never invents a number to fill a card, so the numbers you do see are real.

callouts.text: A dash means not measured, never zero.

callouts.label: So
callouts.title: The numbers you do see are real

scenes.line: Trust is a *gate,* not a promise.
scenes.narration: Sourced claims. Inspected images. Measured numbers. MeYouSocial Publisher. Gates that review as well as block.
